prompts.initial: Create ONE isolated photorealistic LOTION/TREATMENT PUMP INTERNAL CHAMBER WITH ITS CONNECTED DIP TUBE, a reusable transparent component layer. Image 1 is the actual 9 ml lotion bottle reference and is authoritative for the natural slightly bowed tube, elongated polymer mechanism below the collar, soft milky translucency, and upright front view. Image 2 is an existing mechanism draft: use its smooth stepped cylindrical chamber and tube connection, but REMOVE ALL its luminous halo and background haze. This is a LOTION internal assembly, not a fine-mist atomizer: a wider elongated cylindrical chamber with subtle restrained rib/step detail, short tapered connector, and wider flexible round tube, with clearly resolved two tube walls and a soft translucent central bore. Overall visible assembly proportions about 60 units tall, chamber 15 units tall and 6 units wide, tube 1.8 units wide and about 45 units long, mild natural smooth bend over lower half, no kinks. Chamber center axis upright, tube leaves chamber centered, gently bows then ends near axis. Real polypropylene/polyethylene: neutral milky white chamber, translucent tube with soft gray edge reflections, no chrome or glass. Clean crisp focus, understated studio light. ONE continuous component, complete lower open-cut tube tip. No actuator head, no collar, no cap, no bottle, no metal, no spring protruding, no words, no arrows, no shadow or glow outside the object. Genuinely transparent background including all margins, no white matte, no backlit aura, no disconnected dust. Generous clear margins. Preserve natural optical softness but do not blur the silhouette.
prompts.slimmerTip: Precise edit of this lotion-pump internal assembly. Preserve the upper cylindrical pump chamber, small flange, tapered connector, front view and entire upper mechanism exactly. CHANGE ONLY THE LOWER FLEXIBLE TUBE: make it more slender, with one consistent small outside diameter from its connection all the way to the tip, a very mild natural bend, and a tiny clean understated cut end. Remove the flared, chunky, thick-looking oval opening at the bottom. No enlarged end, no bevel flare, no bulb, no thick plug at the tube tip. Lower tube should look like ordinary slim translucent polyethylene tubing, not a curved glass rod. Keep it smoothly attached to the upper mechanism and the same total length. Also remove all exterior gray haze/halo around the object: real transparent alpha outside its tight silhouette. Neutral studio soft highlights inside the polymer only. No bright glowing contour, no background, no labels or extra objects. Clean isolated reusable component for a layered product configurator.
